rv.q: Whitney White's gig-theatre quartet isn't so much exploding Shakespeare as needling at it.
All is But Fantasy is a tremendous achievement and definitely one that makes a mark.
Whatever happens next, though, I’ll never see these Shakespeare plays the same way again.
This feels like a vital piece of theatre.
A thrilling and endlessly surprising subversion of traditional Shakespearean opinions, performed with true heart and commitment.

cn.t: Whitney White's genre-blending "gig theatre" earns praise as an electrifying, subversive reimagining of Shakespeare's female characters, with critics applauding its dazzling music, innovative format, and thought-provoking feminist lens.
